# Walters W.82, Psalter initials and marginalia

Apes, unicorns, dragons, jousters, musicians, hybrids, line fillers and margin borders from the historiated initials and margins of Walters Ms. W.82, a Psalter of about 1315–1325, grouped by folio.

Part of [Ducktape Assets](https://github.com/adrian729/ducktape-assets). Set id `walters-w82`, historical, 62 assets.
